comment.body: Thanks for the follow-up. The current thread does not leave us with a reproducible PowerToys bug to debug: it never identifies which surviving PowerToys process, service, or scheduled task kept starting, and your later comment says you were finally able to remove the remaining files. If a current PowerToys build still relaunches after uninstall, please open a new issue with the exact installed version, install source, the surviving process/service/task name, and whether it still happens after a reboot.
